integrity: General proof identifies the negative curves, classifies negative-definite supports, constructs exact all-denominator Zariski decompositions and big witnesses. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to blow-ups of distinct collinear points. The sharp bound for one reduced denominator and the negative-curve configuration are previously established. Priority of the exact least simultaneous multiple and full denominator spectrum has been compared with selected literature but not established by an exhaustive review. Finite verifier checks n from 2 to 24 and does not prove the all-n claim.
title: Exact universal Zariski denominators on blow-ups of collinear plane points
